correctness.rationale: The forest complex is the independence complex of the rank-13 graphic matroid of connected bridgeless 14-vertex Heawood graph and hence a pure shellable 12-dimensional sphere wedge. For a 21-edge permutation, fixed oriented faces are exactly unions of edge orbits with no graph cycle, and the reduced Lefschetz trace equals -sum of (-1)^(number of included edge orbits). The examined exhaustive checker constructs all 168 GL(3,2) incidence-preserving automorphisms and their 168 dualities and computes the eight (duality flag, edge-cycle) trace rows for all 336; independent DSU/orbit enumeration corroborated every row. The identity trace 3152 is the top Betti rank. Summing traces yields 4704/336=14 full-group fixed classes and 3024/168=18 incidence-preserving fixed classes; index-two duality thus has exactly four negative eigenclasses in the latter 18-dimensional space.
